name: Ukadiche Modak
subtitle: Steamed rice-flour dumplings filled with coconut and jaggery, made for Ganpati

ingredients.note: use oil to keep it vegan

prepNotes: The dough must be kneaded hot. Let it cool and it cracks, and no amount of water will save it. Keep a bowl of water beside you and work fast.
Fresh coconut only. Desiccated makes a dry, grainy filling.

steps.text: For the filling, cook the coconut and jaggery together over medium heat until the jaggery melts and the mixture comes together but is still moist, 8-10 minutes. Add cardamom, nutmeg and poppy seeds. Cool.
steps.tip: Stop while it is still moist; it hardens as it cools.

steps.text: Boil the water with a pinch of salt and a teaspoon of ghee. Take it off the heat, tip in the rice flour all at once and stir hard until no dry flour remains. Cover 5 minutes.
Turn out and knead while hot, greasing your palm with ghee, until completely smooth.
steps.tip: Hot dough. This is the step that decides whether modaks crack.

steps.text: Take a lime-sized ball, flatten into a cup with your fingers, pleat the edge into 9-11 folds, fill, then gather the pleats to a point and seal.
Steam 10-12 minutes until the shells turn glossy and translucent.
Serve warm with a spoon of ghee over the top.

storage: Best within a few hours. Keeps a day refrigerated but the shell hardens; steam 3-4 minutes to soften before serving. Do not freeze.
